description.zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值1。
description.en: Specifies the page number to display in the returned results. The minimum value is 1.

description.zh:
IoT数据源组ProductKey。

> 不传则查询业务链下所有的IoT数据源组。
description.en:
ProductKey of the IoT data source group.

> If not specified, all IoT data source groups under the business chain are queried.

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100。
description.en: Specifies the number of records displayed per page in the returned results. The maximum value is 100.

descriptions.zh:
1. 使用方仅可查看自行注册的IoT数据源组列表。
2. 管理方可查看所创建所有使用方的IoT数据源组列表。

**可访问账号：**
| 业务管理方        | 业务使用方    |
| :--------:   | :-----:   |
| √       | √      |
descriptions.en:
1. Users can only view the list of IoT data source groups they have registered.
2. Administrators can view the list of IoT data source groups for all users they have created.

**Accessible Accounts:**
| Business Administrator        | Business User    |
| :--------:   | :-----:   |
| √       | √      |
